original_plan.expected_observation: At least one accepted control route (direct RL, or residual RL on the advertised compatible reference) returning a passing independent evaluation of a published checkpoint, which could then be frozen with research_plan confirm and reproduced in two fresh post-selection episodes.
original_plan.fixed_conditions: Frozen task 2b26edb4 (target [.29,.035,.19] m, zero initialization, 0.35 s, 0.01 s control, 0.0005 s MuJoCo, acceptance <=0.01 m terminal/holding and <=0.02 m/s holding on inclusive samples 30-35), seed 17, reach_free gravity; acceptance cannot be altered by reward or mathematics; NMPC inadmissible (no matched complete-timing evidence and the synchronous path cannot enforce the authorized hard outer cap); residual requires an advertised compatible runnable reference; no missing-policy or substitute-checkpoint evaluation; all failures retained; mathematical integration and MuJoCo acceptance kept as separate evidence.
original_plan.hypothesis: That a joint length-and-motion optimization of the two-segment 0.27 m tendon arm, followed by a learned controller on the returned design (direct, or residual on the advertised compatible mathematical reference), would yield an original-task-accepted execution confirmable twice.
original_plan.interpretation: The hypothesis is refuted within the authorized routes and budget. Joint optimization: both supported solves converged (Solve_Succeeded) with relaxed-NLP and reduced-model task feasibility, but their optima sit on the acceptance boundary — task_gap gave d=-0.2394 (lengths [0.15868,0.11132], pos 0.00745 m, speed 0.01976 m/s, slacks about -1e-8) and task_gap_with_effort drove d to -0.99998 (lengths [0.15450,0.11550], pos 0.0099998 m, speed 0.0199994 m/s, both essentially on the limits), so the effort-aware objective did NOT buy holding-speed margin. Independent integration (replay 93eb8edc): the .01 s sampled original task is reproduced (pos 0.007449 m, speed 0.018626 m/s) but the integration-consistency gate FAILS (node speed disagreement 0.015009 m/s vs a 0.002 m/s tolerance at t=0.2925 s), so the mathematical reference is NOT independently verified and reduced-model feasibility is not integration-robust in the holding window. Control: direct PPO on candidate ab14d206 (run de294ae0, 199936 actions, training summary fbfd8b7c) failed acceptance with terminal/holding position error 0.0737 m and holding speed 0.0748 m/s (explicitly read result 034b4c19) — a reaching failure; residual PPO on the same candidate with its advertised compatible reference (run 20d4fb90, 199936 actions, training summary 591c1099) reached well (0.00110 m / 0.00126 m) but failed holding speed at 0.0591 m/s (explicitly read result 1056fad5). A third training trial (direct, softened failure penalty -100 and ent_coef 0.01, 400000 actions) was rejected at admission: cumulative RL training ceiling exhausted. Therefore no eligible passing execution exists, NMPC is inadmissible, and the two required confirmations could not be started (0/2, no failures, no invalid executions). Consumption this turn: numerical about 3651 s, elapsed about 4198 s, 2 solves, 2 completed training runs each with 199936 effective actions, 2 development evaluations, 1 replay, 1 rejected third trial. Reported position/speed values are reduced-model or single deterministic-episode values, not robustness or generalization claims; no superiority, global-optimum or root-cause claim is made.
original_plan.stopping_condition: Stop once no authorized route remains to a passing, confirmable execution: NMPC inadmissible, both learned policies failed the frozen thresholds on the selected design, the cumulative RL training ceiling was exhausted (third trial rejected), and at most two solves are used; no further solves, trials, replays or evaluations are attempted.
original_plan.weakening_observation: Both learned controllers failing the frozen thresholds on the selected joint design, the independent integration-consistency gate failing, and the cumulative RL training ceiling being exhausted before any passing checkpoint exists — so no eligible execution can be frozen and no confirmation attempted.
